description: This file defines a PHP class named 'Blog' within the Opencart e-commerce framework. The class provides a method to retrieve articles from the database based on provided filter criteria. It constructs SQL queries with sorting and pagination options, caches results, and interacts with the database connection and cache mechanisms of the framework.
